contract.rejection: Accept the control bus access with AXI SLVERR; preserve roots/ASIDs and emit no flush pulse. Writes do not stall waiting for software retirement.
contract.burst: Remember an error from any accepted beat, including when the final beat succeeds; retain BRESP under backpressure.
contract.addressing: Invalid global AXI addresses cannot drive the truncated register address or modify shadow state.
contract.visibility: A global serialized context boundary; CPU cache maintenance and dependency publication retain their existing software contracts.

earlier_system_cohort.scope_note: Runs the guard before the final stricter client-response presentation check; the final 26-check cohort validates that added check. Do not label the combined cohorts as 49 checks of identical source.

functional.driver_kernel_free_tests: python3 scripts/test_driver.py passed, including ABI, validators, VM/ASID/MMU and packed shader/texture reference checks.
coverage: Reject vector/instruction roots and full flush while an external owner is active, a command remains staged, a result arrives or awaits POP, or reset is active.
Actual integrated stalled descriptor AR remains stable while unsafe writes fail, then a fault result remains intact until POP.
Four-beat write rejects VM mutations while a final harmless read-only beat succeeds; BRESP remains SLVERR across five stalled cycles.
Out-of-map 0x410 write cannot alias legacy CMD_BASE at 0x10.
After retirement, remap VA 0x1000 to PA 0x401000 using Sv32; the new descriptor is fetched physically from the new context.
A translated cease-only kernel executes at PA 0x403000; active compute and its held result prevent VM changes.
Both buffered and unbuffered command clients run the integration workload.
Hold a shared-L2 graphics response for twelve cycles; VM ownership stays busy until response consumption.
